description: Currency exchange rates and conversion for 150+ currencies, updated daily: USD, EUR, GBP, CNY, INR and every African currency, including South African rand (ZAR), Nigerian naira (NGN), Kenyan shilling (KES), Egyptian pound (EGP), Ghanaian cedi (GHS) and CFA francs. Any base currency, optional amount conversion. Mid-market reference rates from an open daily dataset, not official central-bank fixings. Useful for pricing, invoices and reports. Price: $0.002 USDC per call (x402, Base mainnet).

amount.description: Optional amount in the base currency to convert

symbols.description: Comma-separated currency codes to return (default: 18 African currencies plus USD, EUR, GBP, CNY, INR)
